features.wireShape: Legacy: custom { type: 'ready' } frame -> Modern: JSON-RPC readiness probe via session/getState request (or optional agreed session/ready notification)
features.gap: Adapter compatibility gap: Provider expects a legacy custom frame to resolve readyPromise; modern runner is immediately ready for JSON-RPC traffic. Provider should probe via standard public session/getState.
features.minimumTest: Spawn runner, execute JSON-RPC session/getState request, assert valid SessionStateDTO returned within bounded timeout

features.wireShape: Legacy: { type: 'set_model', provider, modelId } -> Modern: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'models/set', params: { provider, modelId } }
features.gap: session-dispatcher.ts contains models/set and models/setThinking, but composition.ts:147-177 uses an inline handler that omits these methods, returning -32601 Method Not Found.
features.minimumTest: Send JSON-RPC models/set with valid provider/modelId, assert { ok: true } and updated model in session state

features.wireShape: Legacy: { type: 'prompt', message, streamingBehavior } -> Modern: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'session/prompt', params: { content, options: { deliverAs: 'followUp' | 'steer' } } }
features.gap: Wire envelope and parameter nesting differences (message vs content, streamingBehavior vs options.deliverAs). Prompt returns genuine native admission receipt with accepted status and real request ID.
features.minimumTest: Submit session/prompt with multi-part text and image, assert response receipt contains non-empty id and status accepted

features.wireShape: Legacy: Raw event JSON line -> Modern: { jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'session/event', params: { event: RunnerEvent } }
features.gap: Real wire events are message_update (carrying assistantMessageEvent: text_delta, thinking_delta, text_start, text_end with contentIndex) and message_end (carrying message: assistantMessageSchema). Modern runner wraps these in session/event notification; provider must unwrap params.event.
features.minimumTest: Stream prompt response, parse session/event notifications with message_update and text_delta, verify delta translator generates ordered BB thread deltas

features.wireShape: Legacy: { type: 'abort' } or file write to control.jsonl -> Modern: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'session/abort' } or { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'session/abortTask', params: { taskId } }
features.gap: Provider server.ts appends to control.jsonl directly on disk for task abort. Runner has session/abortTask in session-dispatcher.ts:54-61, but dispatcher is unmounted in composition.ts:147-177.
features.minimumTest: Trigger async task, send session/abortTask via JSON-RPC, verify engine cancels task and emits cancellation delta

features.wireShape: Legacy: { type: 'get_session_stats' } -> Modern: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'session/getStats' }
features.gap: Method name mismatch (get_session_stats vs session/getStats) and JSON-RPC 2.0 result envelope.
features.minimumTest: Call session/getStats after multi-turn conversation, verify contextTokens and turnCount agree with DB state

features.wireShape: Legacy: event host_tool_call + request host_tool_result -> Modern: Inbound JSON-RPC request from runner { method: 'host/toolCall', params: { toolName, arguments } } and response from host { id, result: { content, isError } }
features.gap: HostBridge is implemented in runner/src/host/host-bridge.ts but NOT instantiated or wired in composition.ts:144-178. Must be injected into composition root as an owned instance (no global module state).
features.minimumTest: Register dynamic tool in runner, trigger tool invocation, verify runner sends host/toolCall request and accepts host response

features.wireShape: Host writes JSON schema file to PI_BB_TOOLS_FILE, runner extension invokes injected HostBridge.forwardToolCall
features.gap: bb-tools-extension.ts imported unexported forwardHostToolCall from durable-zero/core. Dynamic tools extension must consume injected IHostBridge instance instead of module-level global forwarder.
features.minimumTest: Supply PI_BB_TOOLS_FILE with test tool schema, start session, assert tool appears in catalog and routes to HostBridge

features.wireShape: Legacy: { type: 'set_subagent_policy', policyRecord } -> Modern: { jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'session/setSubagentPolicy', params: { policyRecord } }
features.gap: composition.ts:166-168 passes raw params directly to coordinator.setSubagentPolicy without unwrapping policyRecord ?? record ?? params, leading to schema parse errors unless session-dispatcher is mounted.
features.minimumTest: Send session/setSubagentPolicy with updated revision, verify policy persists and is reflected in subagent spawn decisions

features.wireShape: In-process library call: forkSessionDatabase({ sourceDir, targetDir, checkpointId })
features.gap: Provider imports from durable-zero/core where it is not exported. Should import from durable-zero/adapter-pi-durable. Note: runner RPC method session/fork is explicitly typed UnsupportedCapabilityError.
features.minimumTest: Execute forkSessionDatabase on active session SQLite DB, verify new database opens with correct conversation and WAL checkpoint

features.gap: Prompt scratch files (systemPrompt, appendSystemPrompt) are passed via custom CLI flags not parsed by latest cli-args.ts.
features.minimumTest: Pass custom extension and skill directory via CLI args, verify tool definitions and prompt additions load into session

features.wireShape: Process signals: SIGINT, SIGTERM, stdin close
features.gap: Runner main.ts exit handler should ensure instance.close() completes and flushes SQLite WAL before calling process.exit(0).
features.minimumTest: Initiate turn, send SIGTERM, verify runner flushes WAL, closes SQLite, and exits with code 0 within bounded timeout
